title: Space-heating systems.
officialText:
Interior spaces intended for human occupancy shall be provided with active or passive space-heating
systems capable of maintaining a minimum indoor temperature of 68°F (20°C) at a point 3 feet (914 mm) above floor on the design
heating day. The installation of portable space heaters shall not be used to achieve compliance with this section. Refer to Section
1204 of the New York City Building Code.
Exception: Interior spaces where the primary purpose is not associated with human comfort.
SECTION MC 310
EXPLOSION CONTROL
